Model.with_hdp_initial_state() only carries H/w state partially -- true turn-to-turn continuity across multiple simulate calls requires the lower-level jaxfne._pipeline.compile_step_fn/scan_network with the full 6-field DynamicState (v, u, prev_spikes, syn_state, H, w), both of which wrap emitters.simulate_edge_recurrent_izhikevich_hdp directly rather than Model.simulate.
